scheme_name: Natural Calamity Relief to Fishermen of State
other_conditions: Must be contributing to the Fishermen Corpus Relief Fund
Fishing vessel (canoe or mechanized) must be registered with the Department of Fisheries
Applicant must not be a defaulter of the department
Loss or damage must be verified by the competent authority
Loss or damage must be due to natural calamities such as floods, cyclones, tsunamis, or accidental fire
Application must be submitted offline within one week of the incident
benefits_summary: Offers financial compensation up to ₹5 lakhs for death or total disability and up to ₹10 lakhs for loss of fishing vessels, as assessed by authorized surveyors.
